summary.text: Ana Maria Rodriguez represents Florida Senate District 40; Rodriguez was elected to the Senate in 2020 and reelected subsequently, after serving in the Florida House from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the Florida Senate's biography, Rodriguez served on the Doral City Council from 2010 to 2018, including as vice mayor in 2017-2018.

Rodriguez was born in Miami, works as a senior vice president of Miami Realtors, and holds a bachelor's degree from Florida International University (1999) and a master's degree from Nova Southeastern University (2009).
